checks.questionEn: Does duplicating every residual point change the mean-normalised block trace, and does it add physical information?
checks.questionZh: 把每个残差点重复一遍，会改变均值归一化块的迹吗，会增加物理信息吗？
checks.answerEn: With k identical copies of every row, the squared Jacobian sum grows by k while the mean-normalisation denominator also grows by k, so the residual block trace is unchanged. Copies add no new constraint locations or parameter-sensitivity directions. The expanded Gram matrix has a different dimension, including redundant modes, so do not compare average eigenvalues without tracking dimension. New spatial locations can change the trace and the constraint span. Any changed run must use a separate output file and independent field, boundary and residual checks.
checks.answerZh: 把每一行相同地复制 k 次，雅可比平方和乘以 k，而均值归一化的分母也乘以 k，因此残差块的迹不变。复制没有增加新的约束位置或参数敏感度方向。扩展后的 Gram 矩阵维度不同，并包含冗余模式，所以比较平均特征值时必须同时记录维度。新的空间位置可能改变迹与约束张成空间。修改实验必须另存输出，并独立检查场、边界和残差。
